_doc: Emergency fallback only - the live menus come from the CMS admin. NavigationBridgeService reads the CMS Navigation Editor (admin.php?page=ah-navigation) first, from the ah_cms_navigation / ah_cms_nav_cta / ah_cms_footer options, and only falls through to this file if that admin data is missing entirely. The arrays below are intentionally empty so the admin stays the single source of truth; fill one in only if you need the theme to render a menu with no CMS data present.
_header_cta_doc: Admin: Navigation Editor -> CTA button (ah_cms_nav_cta). Shape when used as a fallback: { label, sublabel, route }.
_primary_doc: Admin: Navigation Editor -> main menu (ah_cms_navigation). Shape when used as a fallback: [ { label, url, children: [ { label, url } ] } ].
_footer_doc: Admin: Navigation Editor -> footer columns (ah_cms_footer), read by FooterController. Nothing reads this key today - NavigationService::menu('footer') has no callers - so it is kept only as a documented slot.
